# Interview and practical assessment record

> Structure only; create questions and answers when the corresponding lessons are taught. Do not pre-fill answers.

- Module / sub-phase:
- Date:
- Attempt:
- Status: NOT STARTED

## Multiple-choice questions

Prepare 10 to 15 questions, each with four options, a correct answer, and an explanation. Record score, missed concepts, and corrections.

## One-mark questions

Definitions, terminology, command identification, and concept recognition.

## Five-mark questions

Use a structured explanation: context, concept, operation/steps, example or comparison, and limitations/business relevance.

## Practical demonstration

Record task, starting state, commands/tools, expected result, actual result, and sanitized evidence.

## Troubleshooting scenario

Capture symptoms, evidence, possible causes, investigation, resolution, verification, prevention, and business impact.

## Project walkthrough

Explain what was built, why, technologies, inputs/outputs, dependencies, limitations, problems, and resolutions.

## Readiness scorecard

Score each dimension from 0 to 4, using the syllabus scale. Record evidence and a revision action for any gap.

| Dimension | Score (0 to 4) | Evidence / feedback | Revision action |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Accuracy | | | |

| Communication | | | |
| Project ownership | | | |
